title: Applications and Account Opening — Northgate Card Credit Accounts
content:
**1. Who decides.** Applications for **Northgate Card Credit Accounts (issued by Harbor Point Bank, N.A.)** are taken in store, online or in the app and decided by Harbor Point Bank, N.A.; the agent records the application but never approves, declines or assigns a credit limit.

**2. Customer type.** Consumer tiers accept only consumer profiles and business tiers only business profiles. The tier is open only to a customer whose profile customer type is listed in that tier's entry gate. The customer type is read from the customer profile on record before the application is recorded.

| Tier | Customer type admitted |
|---|---|
| Northgate Secured Card, Northgate Store Card, Northgate Mastercard, Northgate World Mastercard | consumer |
| Northgate Business Store Card, Northgate Business Mastercard | business |

**3. Wait after a decline.** A new application is accepted only when it is made at least the tier's reapply wait days after the declined date of the customer's most recent declined application. Calendar days are added to the declined date, the day after the decline being day 1, and an application on the last day of the wait is still too early. The declined date is the date on the system record of the customer's most recent declined application. On every tier the wait after a decline is the tier's reapply wait days.

With the 30-day wait the card tiers carry:

| Application made on | Result |
|---|---|
| day 29 after the declined date | too early |
| day 30 after the declined date (the last day of the wait) | still too early |
| day 31 after the declined date | accepted |

Hypothetical illustration: after a decline dated on the 2nd of a 31-day month, day 1 is the 3rd and day 30 is the 1st of the next month, so an application on the 1st is still too early and one on the 2nd of the next month is accepted.

**4. Credit limit on approval.** On approval the credit limit lies between the tier's lowest credit limit assigned at opening and its highest credit limit.

**5. Northgate Secured Card.** On Northgate Secured Card the account opens only once a security deposit of at least the tier's minimum refundable security deposit is received, and the credit limit equals the deposit (on Northgate Secured Card the credit limit equals the security deposit).

**6. Where the card is usable.** The card is usable where its network allows, only at Northgate on closed-loop cards.
